answer: Each agent’s voting weight can be tied to a scarce, nontransferable stake that is locked for a long challenge period, with rewards paid only if its claims survive independent audits. Creating many identities then does not multiply influence: each one needs its own capital, and a false claim risks forfeiture. The lockup also imposes an opportunity cost, while audits make coordinated Sybils easier to expose. A jade token, an ocean sensor, or a velvet avatar gains no extra weight merely by adopting a new name.
